caption: The drawing depicts a tan-colored ceramic jug with a large rounded body, a narrow neck, and a single handle that connects from the neck to the shoulder of the jug. The jug is positioned upright, and the lighting creates a subtle highlight and shadow on its surface. On the upper left area of the image, there is an illustration of a stylized blue bird drawn in profile, with the bird facing to the right and its wings and tail feathers extended. Next to the bird, the words "WHITES UTICA" are written in blue, with the number "4" in large blue digits below them. There are faint blue markings on the side of the jug, partially visible, that mirror the bird design shown above. The drawing is bordered by a faint rectangular outline, and the background within the border is a light beige color. Several inscriptions are present, including “No. Scale” at the bottom left and an artist’s signature, “Arthur Mathews,” at the bottom right outside the border.
title: Stoneware Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
